currentParagraphText: “Why do I feel like I should be reporting you to the authorities?” Jake muttered.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Why do I feel like I should be reporting you to the authorities?” Jake muttered.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “If it’s any consolation, we will be working closely with the authorities. At least some of the time. I’ve come to learn that a lot of the work done by the Court of Shadows relies on walking a tightrope between illegality and remaining too useful to get rid of,” Caleb explained. “That’s why Judges are appointed. We are the ultimate authority in day-to-day matters, our job being to ensure what kind of jobs are taken and that the balance is maintained. If we fail, we also happen to be brilliant fall guys as the Court can point to us as having acted independently or been overly incompetent.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “We have a few hits here and there, with Miranda being the biggest client by far,” Caleb said before shaking his head. “But no, the majority of jobs are more akin to traditional mercenary work. Helping clear out monster-infested areas, defending places, and a surprising amount of search and rescue missions. You know, that kind of stuff. I’m fully aware that’s not exactly what people would associate with the Court of Shadows, but we gotta take what we can in these early days. I have confidence that once things calm down, we will have more traditional work. People will always keep making enemies, and when it’s no longer feasible to outright get rid of them yourself, that’s where we come in.”
